source_name: Electricity, hard coal, at power plant

observed_runs.name: Electricity, hard coal, at power plant
Electricity, hard coal, at power plant

cause: Shared aliases select one mutable record for two IAM roles with efficiency caps 0.4 and 0.45. update_electricity_efficiency builds an unordered technology intersection and skips later adjustment after the first role. An aggregate electricity portfolio also falls back to kWh input energy and is treated as a generator.
required_resolution: Separate role-specific physical generator copies and audit aggregate portfolios before efficiency updates, preserving shared transformation logic. Verify different hash seeds without requiring a fixed seed in the public workflow.
scope_note: The preceding fixed-seed diagnostic isolated the independent capture-metadata fix. The coal correction itself has now been verified with different hash seeds and complete exported coal-inventory signatures.
resolution: The existing missing-powerplant stage creates complete role-specific inventory copies from an optional source-family YAML suffix. Portfolio inputs stay within their own role. Both historical coal and IAM efficiency updates require a declared fuel; electricity-only portfolios remain unscaled and missing fuel aliases fail explicitly.
